incidents.summary: Maersk confirmed unauthorised access and data extraction from a legacy system inherited in an acquisition. The disclosure did not identify its location.
SPR reported cyber threats that disrupted access to some digital systems. It coordinated mitigation with NACSA, MKN and JDN and said election operations would continue.
Dementia Singapore reported unauthorised app notifications and possible exposure of some member profile information. It was investigating the scope with its service provider.
SPH Media disclosed cyberattacks affecting five internal systems and exposing personal information in part of its database. The related systems are grouped as one disclosure.

incidents.organisation: Philippine Air Force data breach investigation
incidents.summary: The Armed Forces said its Cyber Command was investigating claims involving Air Force data and assessing whether military systems were affected.
Fireworks AI disclosed unauthorised access via a cloud provider. Notion subsequently reported exposure of AI chat transcripts in a small share of its workspaces.
The university disclosed an active cybersecurity incident and published instructions and updates for its community while it investigated.
The SEC disclosed a data security incident identified on 6 November involving possible exposure of profile information. It reinforced access controls and began checking the scope.
Fullerton Health disclosed access to a server supporting its migrant-worker primary care programme. Preliminary findings identified personal data that might be affected.

incidents.organisation: Bureau of Internal Revenue data leak investigation
incidents.summary: BIR disclosed an investigation with DICT and law enforcement into files alleged to contain agency data. The source and scope were under review.

The Communications Minister reported defacement involving a third-party-managed website. Bank Rakyat described the disruption as a technical issue at its provider and said customer savings and data were safe.
M1 disclosed that customer identity and contact information was involved. The operator said it contained the breach and that services continued.
The healthcare provider confirmed exposure of some user personal data and said clinical records were outside the disclosed scope.
The library attributed an outage affecting on-site computers, Wi-Fi and digital services to a ransomware incident.
The French banking group reported a cyberattack. A follow-up report put the fraudulent transfers at about €100 million.

incidents.organisation: St. Luke’s Medical Center mobile app
incidents.summary: St. Luke’s disclosed a data security incident involving the platform supporting its app. NPC received a breach notification and began reviewing it.
MoneySmart reported that some customer data from its internal systems was copied. The affected customers included users in Singapore and Hong Kong.
The Brazilian exchange paused deposits and withdrawals following a security incident involving transfers across several blockchains.
Binance reported a security incident involving unauthorised digital asset transfers. It subsequently issued preliminary findings and described its response.
Fore confirmed unauthorised access to a platform it uses to manage customer information. Komdigi later reviewed the company’s notification.
Unauthorised access at Amadeus affected airline booking information. Malaysia Airlines, Singapore Airlines and Thai Airways disclosures refer to the same supplier incident.
Alliance Medinet disclosed a breach affecting its members. HSBC Life, Income Insurance and Singlife customers were among those affected by the same provider incident.
The university disclosed access to a test environment holding personal information and reviewed the records involved.
DigiCert reported that unauthorised access to an internal business system exposed some archived customer details and identity documents.
Reporting cited by CERT-EU described unauthorised access to party email mailboxes through a hosting provider and subsequent publication of messages.
South Korea's financial authorities reported related hacking incidents across 16 financial firms. The public aggregate disclosure is one register entry.
A network security incident prompted precautionary shutdowns. Some US retail web services were interrupted while stores remained open.
Tabung Haji temporarily suspended services following a cyberattack and subsequently reported restoration of key services.
Reporting cited by CERT-EU described unauthorised access to medical data during a second breach affecting the sector that month.
Unauthorised access reached files holding a limited subset of consumer information. CTOS reported it contained the environment and began remediation.
Helpfeel disclosed unauthorised access involving its Gyazo service and later revised the scope of potentially affected records.
MUIS said the payroll provider’s system was affected, including data for mosques and madrasahs. MUIS arranged alternate payroll processing.
A traffic flood reportedly interrupted services at the Portuguese telecom operator.
Duopharma disclosed a cybersecurity incident and reported preliminary findings of file extraction. Its forensic investigation was assessing the scope of the affected files.

sources.label: Bursa Malaysia announcement via KLSE Screener

incidents.summary: Tokyo Metro reported that an unauthorised third party accessed email addresses of some Metpo loyalty programme users.
SIMBA reported that an incident exposed customer contact and identity information and said it contained the breach.
A public incident timeline reported detection of ransomware-linked malware in operational networks at the South African air navigation provider.
Berlin's administration confirmed a theft and extortion incident involving data from two Senate departments.
Reporting cited by CERT-EU said a cyberattack forced a small generator to shut down for several days.
The government attributed unauthorised access to leaked credentials and announced a move towards multi-factor authentication. Authorities investigated the scope of the exposed information.
The service confirmed that police, government and customer contact details had been compromised.
Authorities reported unauthorised access to and copying of data from the beneficial ownership register, then took the affected system offline.
The ministry reported encryption of parts of its infrastructure and interrupted digital services. COLCERT collected evidence for forensic review.
Hungary reported a breach affecting the treasury and ransomware deployment at the Agricultural and Rural Development Office.

incidents.organisation: Central Java social assistance data platform
incidents.summary: Central Java’s government disclosed its response to suspected exposure of social-assistance records after notification from BSSN. It said the system had been restored.
Maxis confirmed unauthorised access after a customer’s account and billing details appeared on social media. Malaysia’s Personal Data Protection Department opened an investigation.
An intrusion led to the loss of some systems and backups and interrupted online property-registration services.

incidents.organisation: Ministry of Home Affairs legal information portal
incidents.summary: Local reporting documented unauthorised replacement content on the ministry’s public legal information portal and interruption of normal access.
Coca-Cola disclosed a cybersecurity incident affecting fairlife technology systems and reported interruptions to US production.
Latvia's cyber response team reported that ransomware disrupted services of the state forestry company and that internal data was leaked.
SLA disclosed unauthorised access to personal information in a development and testing data set managed by its vendor IBM.
Nidec disclosed ransomware affecting the network of its Taiwanese subsidiary.
Indra confirmed a ransomware incident affecting a subsidiary and said it contained the incident while maintaining service continuity.
Aflac Japan disclosed unauthorised access to systems holding policyholder information and began notifying regulators and affected individuals.

incidents.organisation: Malaysia Health Ministry and agency websites
incidents.summary: NACSA linked several Malaysian government website compromises to the same Joomla extension vulnerability. The Health Ministry confirmed its public portal had been compromised.

sources.label: Health Ministry confirmation via Malay Mail

incidents.summary: Public reporting described access to some work mobile and email information after exploitation of mobile-device management flaws.
DICT investigated defacement of the House website on 13 June and activated its incident response.
DICT and Senate officials reported that the public Senate website had been defaced and that the response team was investigating the incident.
Novo Nordisk reported access to some internal systems, involving pseudonymised trial information and some healthcare-provider contact details.
The university confirmed that an external party accessed data affecting current and former students. The UK disclosure established the impact recorded here.
Lithuania reported that an attacker gained access to a system holding professional and administrative records. The central e-health system was outside the reported scope.
Press Legal Aid reported a separate denial-of-service wave beginning 5 June 2026 that disrupted public access to Tempo’s site.
GitHub investigated access to internal repositories following installation of a malicious editor extension.
An unauthorised party used a token to reach the company's GitHub environment and copy code. Grafana investigated the scope of access.
IBM said it contained a security incident affecting its Italian subsidiary and restored services.
Trellix disclosed unauthorised access to part of a source-code repository and investigated the scope.
Unauthorised access affected Canvas account and course-related information. The vendor described the later access and maintenance period in the same incident update.
Researchers reported an alleged leak involving the Kuala Lumpur-based federation’s registration data. The report was based on an extortion claim.
Medtronic disclosed unauthorised access to certain corporate IT systems and began investigating the information involved.
Thailand’s data-protection authority said the council had discovered a breach, notified the regulator and was contacting affected data subjects.
The national agency for secure documents disclosed a security incident that could expose some users' identity and contact information.
Traffic flooding caused intermittent outages affecting features such as feeds, search and notifications.
A compromise involving a third-party integration enabled access to some internal Vercel systems. Vercel notified affected customers and issued security guidance.
BELFOR disclosed a regional network incident involving data theft. Its country notices describe the same regional case, including operations in Thailand.
A public notice said part of the companies' IT systems had been affected and that certain personal data might have been accessed or copied.
An attacker accessed a student-account management service and downloaded some pupils' information.
Okamura disclosed suspected access to a Thai subsidiary’s servers in December and said it was investigating information suspected to have leaked online.
Sumitomo Metal Mining disclosed a ransomware incident involving servers of its Philippine nickel subsidiary and began investigating affected systems.
Bank Negara Malaysia disclosed that an external actor had gained access to the bank’s IT infrastructure. Its enforcement notice reported control gaps and remedial measures taken by the bank.
The police reported that a phishing attack gave an external party access. Its security team detected and blocked the intrusion.
The ministry confirmed access to some systems and blocked compromised accounts or access paths while investigating.
Reporting cited by CERT-EU described an intrusion and the extraction of email data from Costa Rica's electricity and telecommunications provider.
A cyberattack interrupted global corporate systems, including operations in Ireland. Stryker subsequently reported disruption to ordering and manufacturing.
An attack affected internal parliamentary computers and email service and attempted to delete data.
France reported that stolen credentials were used to reach records in its national bank-account database.
Repeated traffic floods disrupted Deutsche Bahn's website, app and digital ticketing services.
Odido notified customers of a cyberattack that exposed information held in a customer-contact system.
The Romanian pipeline operator reported a cyber incident affecting corporate IT and its website. Operational technology continued functioning.
MFE disclosed that ransomware had exposed some internal files, including material relating to customers and suppliers. It notified Malaysia’s Personal Data Protection Commissioner.
Eurail reported access to customer and DiscoverEU participant information, including some identity and reservation data.

incidents.organisation: La Poste and La Banque Postale / January recurrence
incidents.summary: Renewed attack traffic disrupted postal and banking web services in January after the separate December interruption.
Bangchak detected unauthorised access to personal data, changed account passwords and coordinated its response with Thailand’s cybersecurity authority.
Romania's cyber authority disclosed an attack that encrypted IT devices and disrupted internal communications. Operational water infrastructure remained functional.

incidents.organisation: La Poste and La Banque Postale
incidents.summary: A traffic flood interrupted French postal and online banking services. La Poste reported that parcels and letters continued to move.
Venezuela's state oil company reported a cyberattack. The company and Reuters' sources gave different accounts of the operational impact.
The ministry reported that an attacker accessed some files via compromised email servers. Authorities investigated the extent of access.
The trust reported theft of invoice data after exploitation of an Oracle business software flaw. Clinical systems continued operating.
The parent company disclosed unauthorised access to a server used by its Malaysian subsidiary. Its later investigation confirmed that some information had leaked and some data had been encrypted.
Araneta Group disclosed a cybersecurity incident affecting TicketNet and two related businesses. The group’s disclosure is recorded as one brief.
Coupang disclosed unauthorised access to customer information relating to its South Korean business.
Salesforce and Gainsight investigated unauthorised access to customer Salesforce instances associated with compromised integration credentials.
Eurofiber disclosed an intrusion affecting the ticketing platform used by its French operation.
The Italian industrial-gas company confirmed an intrusion involving a perimeter system and said its operations continued.
A suspected ransomware incident disrupted the broadcaster's internal systems and limited newsroom operations.
F5 disclosed unauthorised access to its internal systems and the extraction of some BIG-IP source code and vulnerability information.

incidents.organisation: Dutch National Institute for Public Health and the Environment
incidents.summary: RIVM temporarily shut its website after exploitation of a web-form component and restricted access to affected forms.
A ransom message appeared on the association’s competition management website, which holds registration and competition records. The report described the message and the site compromise.
A cyberattack took multiple Latvian public websites and electronic-signature services offline temporarily.
A cyberattack disrupted Japanese operations, including parts of the company's order processing and shipping systems.
DICT reported defacements of public government sites during the 21 September protests. This brief covers the grouped public report.
JLR took systems offline following a cyber incident. Retail and manufacturing activity were disrupted.
The operator reported that a cyberattack exposed personal and contract information, including some bank-account identifiers.
The automotive distributor disclosed unauthorised access affecting customer records and said it had notified the relevant authorities.
A cyberattack disrupted support and customer-facing platforms. The company reported that its core network was unaffected.
A shared customer-service provider was breached, exposing some customer contact and loyalty programme information. The related airline disclosures are grouped as one supplier incident.
Orange reported a security incident that temporarily disrupted services for some customers, principally in France.
The agency confirmed a breach linked to exploitation of on-premises SharePoint. Officials reported limited operational disruption.
An attack caused a nationwide interruption to mobile, landline and internet services, including access to emergency numbers.
Singapore disclosed activity against critical infrastructure in July 2025. In February 2026, CSA and IMDA confirmed the same campaign targeted all four major telecoms operators.
The ministry restored its website after unauthorised content was posted. Thai officials described steps to investigate and secure the site.
The technology distributor disclosed ransomware on internal systems and took services offline during containment.
Qantas disclosed unauthorised access to a third-party customer servicing platform used by one of its contact centres.
Researchers identified a data-wiping operation targeting organisations in Albania.
Aflac said it interrupted an intrusion into its US network and began reviewing potentially affected files.
Thai government and media websites experienced disruptions during a wave of politically motivated denial-of-service activity reported in June. The related reports are grouped into one brief.
WestJet investigated suspicious activity involving internal systems and later issued updates on the information involved.

incidents.organisation: Farm’s Best Food Industries / CAB Cakaran
incidents.summary: CAB Cakaran disclosed a breach of its subsidiary’s accounting system and began recovery and impact assessment.

sources.label: The Star, citing Bursa Malaysia filing

incidents.summary: Police said the home minister’s WhatsApp account was compromised and used to send malicious links to contacts.
A compromised account used for software collaboration enabled access to personal data held by the US data broker.
The Ohio healthcare network reported a cyber incident that disrupted technology systems, affecting some scheduled care and communications.
NACSA acknowledged a cybersecurity incident after several city services became unavailable. Its initial assessment pointed to malware, and DBKL announced a phased restoration.
Coinbase reported that criminals recruited some overseas support personnel to obtain customer information and attempted to extort the company.
Local reporting documented compromise of the municipal traffic-camera site, which redirected visitors to unrelated content.
Co-op restricted access to parts of its IT network after detecting an attack and later reported that customer and member data had been accessed.
A joint cybersecurity review identified an intrusion into ministry systems. Guatemala's foreign ministry described activity extending into February 2025.
SK Telecom disclosed unauthorised access that exposed some subscriber USIM information and began protective measures for customers.
M&S reported a cyber incident that affected its retail operations and took action to restore services.
Tempo reported traffic flooding that began on 6 April and made its news website difficult to access.

incidents.organisation: German Association for East European Studies
incidents.summary: German authorities investigated an intrusion affecting the research association's email accounts.
CSA and MAS said ransomware at the printing supplier compromised customer information associated with DBS and Bank of China. The bank disclosures refer to the supplier incident.
The ministry disabled its remote access service after identifying suspicious activity and referred the matter for investigation.
Malaysia Airports and NACSA investigated a cybersecurity incident at KLIA. The initial statement said flight operations continued. NACSA later identified the case as ransomware.
Ukraine's rail operator experienced interruptions to online ticketing and its mobile app. Train services continued.
Bank Indonesia attributed disruption to its cash-exchange booking system to denial-of-service activity and said access had been restored.
The party confirmed that someone had gained access to its official Facebook and Instagram accounts and published unauthorised posts.
A compromised credential allowed access to Ascom's Jira system. The company reported that business operations were unaffected.
HomeTeamNS disclosed ransomware affecting some servers containing employee and member-related information.
Traffic floods interrupted access to the Dutch authentication service used to reach public services.
Reporting cited by CERT-EU described access to intelligence-service email through a vulnerable mail security system during 2021–2023.
An attacker encrypted parts of the publishing company's network. The company reported disruptions to business operations and took steps to contain the incident.
Indonesia’s communications ministry investigated suspected access involving staff information and reported containment measures for the affected environment.

The FBI attributed the theft of approximately US$1.5 billion in virtual assets from the exchange to North Korea. The incident record omits an affected-country pin because the cited notice describes the exchange rather than a victim location.
Ransomware compromised personal information relating to clients, contractors and employees of the Polish electronic-signature provider.
The university disconnected its network after identifying a cyberattack, interrupting classes, exams and access to digital services.
The registry took systems offline after an attack that interrupted land and property services.
A traffic flood interrupted access to parts of Docomo's web services, including the goo portal.
A compromise involving the student information system exposed data held for school districts. The Toronto District School Board issued notices to its community.

THA.summary: Thailand’s Transport Ministry called for stronger aviation cybersecurity after the Thai Airways passenger-record disclosure. The case is recorded under Amadeus.
THA.label: The Nation

IDN.summary: Komdigi urged public agencies to strengthen monitoring and incident response after warnings of threats to government services. This is preparedness guidance.
IDN.label: DetikInet

PHL.summary: The NPC is assessing agency breach notifications from its 10 November release. This coverage follows that release and also reports on the Air Force investigation.
PHL.label: DZRH follow-up
